name: KDB.AI
tagline: KX's vector database for time-aware AI search, with temporal similarity and hybrid retrieval.
description: KDB.AI is a vector database from KX, the company behind the kdb+ time-series database used throughout capital markets. Its distinguishing feature is time-aware retrieval: Temporal Similarity Search finds similar patterns across time-series windows without precomputed embeddings, and searches can be constrained by time alongside metadata. It offers qFlat and qHNSW indexes (on-disk variants that cut memory), IVF-PQ, and hybrid dense plus sparse search, accessed via Python and REST. It makes most sense for teams in the KX/kdb ecosystem or with financial and sensor time-series; general RAG teams have broader options.

pricing.notes: Free sign-up for a KDB.AI licence for development; enterprise licensing and support via KX sales.

scale.notes: Server Edition runs as a Docker container; on-disk qHNSW/qFlat indexes reduce RAM needs.

strengths: Temporal Similarity Search over raw time series
Time-windowed filtering combined with vector search
On-disk qHNSW and qFlat indexes lower memory cost
Fits naturally with existing kdb+ estates
weaknesses: Proprietary with a small developer community
Python and REST are the only first-class interfaces
Limited public pricing and roadmap information
useCases: Pattern matching in market and sensor time series
RAG over financial documents with time constraints
